text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
CORN SALE - Taiwan's FGEP corn-buying group bought one 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. No.2 corn from Mitsubishi Corp at a tender on Thursday, traders said.

- Iran bought between 150,000 and 200,000 tonnes of Argentine maize at around $118 per tonne, FOB, last weekend and further purchases cannot be ruled out, European grain traders said. One exporter said Iran planned to tender on April 21 to buy 120,000 tonnes of optional-origin maize.
WHEAT SALE - Philippine firms bought 65,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, Manila grains traders said. The negotiations were concluded on Wednesday night.

WHEAT AND BARLEY SALE - Japan's Food Agency said on Thursday it bought 60,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, 60,000 of Canadian wheat, 20,000 of Australian wheat, 20,000 of U.S. barley and 20,000 of Australian barley at its weekly tender.

CORN TENDER - The CCC said it was tendering on April 22 for up to 9,690 tonnes of U.S. corn for export to Kenya and Angola, May 5-31 shipment. The total comprised up to 5,000 tonnes for Angola and up to 4,690 tonnes for Kenya.
WHEAT TENDER - Taiwan will retender on April 23 for two shipments of U.S. wheat totalling 68,000 tonnes. Taiwan had passed on the tender on Tuesday due to high prices.
WHEAT TENDERS - Iraq will tender on April 18 for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat, U.S. exporters said. The wheat will be slated for June arrival.

- CCC said it was seeking up to 7,220 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat, maximum moisture 13.5 percent, under the export program for Bosnia. The shipment period was set for May 7-31 and offers were due April 21.
DURUM TENDER - Algeria seeks 100,000 tonnes of optional durum wheat for shipment in May and June.

SOYBEAN TENDER - South Korea will tender on Friday for 20,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 soybeans for April 25-May 15 shipment from the U.S. Gulf. Arrival was scheduled by June 20 to the western port of Inchon.

SOYOIL TENDER - State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp will tender on Friday for a shipment of 2,500 tonnes of soyoil, company officials said. The shipment would be slated for delivery by the end of May, a company official said.
SORGHUM TENDER - The CCC will tender April 22 for up to 5,000 tonnes sorghum for export to Kenya, May 5-31 shipment.
BARLEY TENDER - Turkey's tender for 150,000 tonnes of barley contains three shipments of 50,000 tonnes of white feed and malting white barley for May 15-22, June 1-15 and June 1-15 shipment.
RICE TENDERS - Costa Rica will tender April 16 for 26,500 tonnes optional origin long grain rough rice or 18,000 tonnes long grain milled rice.
- South Korea is expected to tender at the end of June to buy 77,000 tonnes of rice to meet its 1997 WTO quota.

MARKET TALK - U.S. wheat will be back at the center of world wheat export trade this summer after the end of European Union weekly wheat tenders for the current season to July, industry analysts and exporters said.

"If exports out of Europe are suspended, it would most definitely affect our U.S. wheat exports," a senior U.S. wheat export trader said. "There is no alternative but the U.S. when you are talking July, August and September (positions)."
"Australia was supposedly almost all sold out. Argentina is sold out and now Europe is saying they are suspending," the trader said.
The EU ended the bulk of its July/June wheat export sales on Thursday by closing its weekly tender system. But it left the door ajar to exporters seeking last-minute supplies.

Thursday's decision coincided with fresh awards that added at least 400,000 tonnes to the volume released for export and pushed this season's sales above 9.6 million tonnes. An EU official said it may allow another 70,000 tonnes on Friday.
